timingBasis: Controller receipt of accepted nonempty events, relative to audio origin; excludes setup/load and pixel rendering; audio origin is not a click timestamp.
submitBasis: MT submitted timestamp is unavailable unless an explicit submit/submitted event exists; requestStarted is separately reported.
inferenceBasis: inferenceMs is inference wall duration. started.previewIntervalMs samples the configured interval at inference start; completed.previewIntervalMs is the updated interval for subsequent previews. Both ratios are separate and are not observed audio-arrival cadence or dropped-frame measurements. Snapshot-end lag also includes input delivery, scheduling and waiting.

historicalSmallCpuBackground.scope: One historical CPU run; excluded from current aggregates. Different version/backend and one run cannot isolate optimization causes. Legacy inference/RTF describe only the last window.

semanticReview.scope: Qualitative four-point review of this one public sample; no translation accuracy percentage.
semanticReview.method: Direct bilingual review of the final subtitles from all six reports; all final Chinese texts were identical.

accuracyScope: WER scores the final source of one 22-word sample; repetitions are not independent accuracy samples and 0 WER is not general accuracy.
modelLoadBasis: Test-entry controller.loadModel duration includes selected-weight verification (_verifySelectedModel -> verifyModel) and whisper.load; not pure Metal initialization. Native luma_create has a separate scope. A GUI start with an already-ready model can reuse it; no click-to-start latency is measured here.

preparationOutlier.causeEvidence: Passive process sample placed the main-thread wait in SecItemCopyMatching before audio began; the user handled system authorization and the same run then completed.
preparationOutlier.interpretation: System authorization wait is part of preparation, not an ASR or MT inference duration. No click timestamp was recorded. Controller model loading is separately measured and its internal cost is not decomposed.

cacheScope: The machine GPU compilation cache had previous initialization. The paced test entry separately records controller loading and growing-window inference; the native benchmark repeats warm calls on one handle. These are not first-install cold-start measurements.
